name: Beaufort West
routeRole: Historically documented Shosholoza Meyl stop; featured tourism place
story: As Lerato's simulated journey crosses the Karoo, Beaufort West becomes more than a name on the route. The town offers a way to explore local history at the Beaufort West Museum, while Karoo National Park offers a separate visit focused on the landscape and natural heritage. Rails & Roots helps her discover these possibilities and save them for a future trip.
visitorNote: The museum and national park are separate from the railway station. This record does not confirm a current passenger train, a station-to-attraction transfer, opening hours, entry fees or whether either place can be visited during a train stop. Check each attraction before planning a visit.
